name: memory_relate
description: Create or update a directed edge 'source relation_type target' between two distinct entities (created if missing). Use clinical technical entity names, relation types, and metadata only.

target.description: Target entity name (must differ from source).

relation_type.description: Forward verb in snake_case, e.g. depends_on, hosted_on, deploys_to, provisions, governs, references, synchronizes_with, stores_data_for, authenticates_against.

weight.description: Edge strength, 1.0 on create, unchanged on update if omitted.

metadata.description: Edge key/values (max 4000 serialized characters), merged with existing ones (null deletes a key).
